title: finding phonemes
brief: discovery-focused word game where players unlock new phonemes by creating different words with available letters.

details.heading: System Highlight
details.text: integrated CMU Pronouncing Dictionary and sound library for phoneme detection and feedback

details.heading: Design Insight
details.text: one consonant can represent multiple phonemes, enabling exploration and replayability

details.heading: Iteration
details.text: Shifted from rapid guessing to deliberate discovery by introducing negative scoring

details.heading: Feedback
details.text: positive response for progress feedback; next iteration on responsive game balance curve

title: i like the sound of you
brief: romance visual novel where players identify correct phonemic dialogue choices to impress their poetry club crush.

details.heading: System Highlight
details.text: Scalable narrative design to align with curriculum and expand character sets

details.heading: Design Insight
details.text: externalized phonemic learning goals by tapping into hi-lo books' reading motivation

details.heading: Iteration
details.text: adapted a DDLC–inspired word selection mini-game to reinforce phoneme choices

details.heading: Feedback
details.text: described as “refreshing & hilarious,” opening new directions for educational visual novels

title: phony mystery
brief: detective adventure game where players collect phonemes from environmental clues to solve mysteries, combining narrative intrigue with systematic phonics learning.

details.heading: Learning Goal
details.text: phoneme pattern recognition through investigative gameplay (bed → b eh d, then bread → b r eh d)

details.heading: Key Insight
details.text: modular dialogue system enabled flexible narrative flow while maintaining educational focus

details.heading: Technical Highlight
details.text: integrated cmu pronunciation library with unity for accurate phoneme breakdown and audio recitation

details.heading: Design Evolution
details.text: shifted from 3d to 2d click-and-point interface for rapid content iteration and testing

title: cards against reason
brief: social card game inspired by cards against humanity, using phoneme-focused word cards for absurd sentence creation with educational reinforcement.

details.heading: Learning Goal
details.text: phoneme-word association through repetition and creative application

details.heading: Key Insight
details.text: social gameplay engaged middle schoolers more than individual learning activities

details.heading: Design Innovation
details.text: wild card system allowed flexible phoneme substitution while maintaining game flow

details.heading: Iteration Focus
details.text: identified need for more scaffolding to reduce performance pressure for humor
